item.title: Canada Day Celebration 2024
item.description: Canada Day Celebration 2024 Collaborators: Gibson House Museum Format: Public workshop Location: Toronto Topics: Carpet / Kilim / Tapestry weaving On Canada Day,2024, our team had the honor of collaborating with Gibson House Museum and holding an art workshop centered on traditional Iranian textiles. During this event, the arts of Persian carpet, kilim, and tapestry were introduced to the audience, and families were able to share a hands-on, inspiring experience of Iranian art together.

item.title: Willowdale Nowruz Celebration 2024
item.description: Willowdale Nowruz Celebration 2024 Collaborators: Willowdale City Office and Tirgan Organization Format: Public workshop Location: Toronto Topics: Carpet / Kilim / Tapestry weaving During the Nowruz Festival on March 9, 2024, our team had the pleasure of collaborating with Willowdale City Office and Tirgan Organization in holding an interactive Persian Carpet, Kilim and Tapestry workshop designed for attendees of all ages. Through individual training, we provided a brief overview of traditional weaving techniques, allowing participants to experience weaving the craft firsthand.
